name: Trideviyaan
description: Dhanashree and Tanuja, along with their sister-in-law, Manya, work as secret agents and simultaneously manage their household chores. However, they have a tough time hiding their real identities.

videos.title: Garg Ki Shaadi
videos.overview: Garg tells his father Dinanath that he is making his wedding video. Garg and his family gather for family photograph. Tanu tells her mother that she doesn't wish to marry Garg.

videos.title: Tanu Ka Grihapravesh
videos.overview: Tanu saves her family from their kidnappers. Tanu's in-laws welcome her to their house.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Agent Lal Kila brings Tanu to her secret office. Tanu's father-in-law shows her various devices through which they can contact each other.

videos.title: Tanu and Dhanu Seize Two Thieves
videos.overview: Tanu and Dhanu enter the kitchen and seize the two thieves. Tannu tells her father-in-law that Manu has taken her earrings.

videos.title: Agent Himalaya Finds a Secret Chip
videos.overview: Dhanu asks Tanu to prepare food for her family. Agent Himalaya informs Dhanu that he has found a chip in the bag. He advises Dhanu to help Tanu in the kitchen.

videos.title: Goon in a Beauty Parlour
videos.overview: Dinanath informs Tanu and Dhanu that a goon is going to attack Manu in a beauty parlour. Tanu and Dhanu plan to go to the beauty parlour to save Manu.

videos.title: Tanu and Dhanu Beat the Goons
videos.overview: "Tanu and Dhanu enter the beauty parlor and save Manu from the goons. Dinanath brings his wife to a sweets shop.

videos.title: Tanu Serves Food to Her Family
videos.overview: Dinanath’s family gather for lunch. Tanu serves food to her family. Her in-laws tell her that they had seen a few goons in the beauty parlour.

videos.title: Dinanath Reveals His Secret to Manu
videos.overview: Manu asks Dinanath, Tanu and Dhanu to share their top secret with her. She further tells Dinanath that she wishes to work along with him as a secret agent.

videos.title: Manu Ki Wish
videos.overview: Dhanu tells Dinanath that Manu wishes to become a secret agent. Dinanath tells Dhanu and Tanu that they would take Manu along with them to a fake mission.

videos.title: Dinanath Plans to Marry Manu Off
videos.overview: Dinanath and his family plan to fix Manu’s marriage. They invite a young man to their house to introduce him to Manu.

videos.title: Manu Locks Manav in Her Room
videos.overview: Manu stands before the goons and asks them to release Dhanu and Tanu. Dinanath learns that Manu has locked Manav in her room.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Dinanath appoints Manu as a secret agent in his mission. Manu tells Dinanath that he should give her a medal for saving Dhanu and Tanu’s lives.

videos.title: Dinanath Appoints Manu as Secret Agent
videos.overview: Dinanath appoints Manu as a secret agent in his mission. Manu tells Dinanath that he should give her a medal for saving Dhanu and Tanu's lives.

videos.title: Manu's Training to Become Secret Agent
videos.overview: Tanu and Dhanu's mother-in-law yells at them for asking Manu to wash clothes. Manu tells her mother that her sister-in-laws are training her household chores.

videos.title: Manu on a Mission
videos.overview: Garv tells Tanu that he wishes to spend some time with her. Dhanu instructs Manu to force Garv to walk out of his room.

videos.title: Tanu Completes Her Mission
videos.overview: Tanu informs Dinanath that she has successfully completed her mission. Dinanath learns that Tanu is sitting inside Shaurya's jeep.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Attack the Goons in the Party
videos.overview: Manu's mother advises her to not follow Dhanu and Tanu's orders. Dinanath instructs his three secret agents to punish the goons who have entered into the party.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Resolve to Stay United
videos.overview: Suhasini asks Tanu to prepare food for her friend Mandakini Mehra. Trideviyaan assures Dinanath that they will remain united in the future.

videos.title: Tolaram Ka Godown
videos.overview: Diwakar tells his agents that the jeweler might know Ghamosha in person. He instructs Agent Lal Kila to check Tolaram's godown.

videos.title: Manu Plans to Arrest Tolaram
videos.overview: Dhanu tells Tanu that she should not have interfered in her in the secret mission. Manu assures Dhanu and Tanu that she will find and arrest Tolaram.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Plan to Hunt Tolaram
videos.overview: Trideviyaan plan to hunt Tolaram in the city. Tanu learns that Dhanu's husband Shaurya is involved in various crimes.

videos.title: Tanu Plans to Seize the Smuggler
videos.overview: Tanu assures Dinanath that she will find out the policeman who is involved in the smuggling of gold. Shaurya tells Garv that the police commissioner wishes to meet him and Tanu.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Plans to Detain Shaurya
videos.overview: Tanu tells Dhanu and Manu that an international dance group would perform in the annual function of the police department. Trideviyaan plan to visit the function in the guise of the dance performers.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Fail to Arrest Shaurya
videos.overview: Trideviyaan plan to secretly arrest Shaurya from the annual function of the police department. They enter Shaurya's room but fail to catch him.

videos.title: Police Arrest Shaurya
videos.overview: Shaurya reaches the seashore to seize Kitu and his goons. He requests the police to arrest him. Dhanu gets shocked to see Shaurya in jail.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Shaurya tells Dhanu that he has deliberately put himself behind bars. Dhanu informs her family that she is looking forward to celebrate her wedding anniversary.

videos.title: Titu Befriends Shaurya
videos.overview: Fatte comes to Dinanath's house. Titu praises Shaurya for not revealing his secret to the police. Dhanu's family comes up with various ways to make her cry.

videos.title: Shaurya Stops Kitu From Escaping Jail
videos.overview: Dhanu's family plans to put her on sleep. Later, Shaurya stops Kitu from escaping the jail.

videos.title: Shaurya Beats Kitu
videos.overview: Shaurya beats Kitu and his goons in the police station. Shaurya tells his family that he will throw a party when he will find Gamosha.

videos.title: Dinanath Ka Locket
videos.overview: Dhanu tells Dinanath that she had given his locket to Shaurya. Shaurya's boss tells him that Gamosha may harm him in the future.

videos.title: Gamosha Threatens Shaurya
videos.overview: Gamosha plans to blow up Dinanath's house with a bomb. Gamosha makes a call to Shaurya. He asks Shaurya to release Kitu from jail.

videos.title: Bomb in Shaurya's House
videos.overview: Gamosha informs Shaurya's brother that soon his house will be blown up with a bomb. Shaurya brings bomb disposal squad to his house.

videos.title: Shaurya Finds the Watermelon Bomb
videos.overview: Trideviyaan arrange an outdoor game for their guests. Shaurya finds the bomb kept in a watermelon. He ties to watermelon to Kitu's hands.

videos.title: Shaurya Arrests Kitu
videos.overview: Shaurya tells Gamosha that he has arrested Kitu. Gamosha assumes that Kitu has passed away. An astrologer assures Gamosha that Kitu is alive.

videos.title: Shaurya Receives a Mysterious Courier
videos.overview: Dinanath's wife tells her family that Parmindar Chaddha has made marriage proposal for Manu. Shaurya receives a courier from an anonymous person.

videos.title: Manu Refuses to Marry Nikhil
videos.overview: Manu clears it to Dhanu and Tanu that she doesn't wish to get married. Gamosha decides to take revenge against Shaurya once returning from a retreat.

videos.title: Chanda Meets Dhanu and Tanu
videos.overview: Chanda Chadhha meets Dhanu and Tanu in the restaurant. On the other hand, Nikhil comes to Dinanath's house to meet Manu.

videos.title: Chanda Chaddha Comes to Dinanath's House
Chanda Finds Out Shaurya and Dhanu's Relationship
videos.overview: Nikhil requests Chanda Chaddha to forgive Manu's family for their mistake. Chanda Chaddha finds out Shaurya's relationship with Dhanu.

videos.title: Manu Steals Nikhil's Mobile Phone
videos.overview: Chanda Chaddha questions Trideviyaan about Shaurya and Dhanu's relationship with each other. Manu appears before Nikhil in the guise of a security guard.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Appear Before Gamosha
videos.overview: Manu informs Dhanu and Tanu that she has stolen Nikhil's mobile phone. Trideviyaan appear before Gamosha in a dark room.

videos.title: Manu Secretly Enters Nikhil's Room
videos.overview: Trideviyaan cracks the password of Nikhil's mobile phone. Dinanath assures Nikhil that he would soon find out his mobile phone. Manu secretly enters into Nikhil's room.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Trideviyaan plan to search Nikhil's secret box. They soon learn that Nikhil has kept Manu's childhood photos in the box. Nikhil tells Dinanath's family that he had a secret crush on Manu since his childhood.

videos.title: Dinanath Brings Gamosha to His House
videos.overview: Chanda Chaddha's car hits Gamosha in front of Dinanath's house. Dinanath tells his family that they must look after Gamosha's health. Dinanath's family bring Gamosha in their house.

videos.title: Gamosha Ka Game Plan
videos.overview: Dinanath's family assumes that Gamosha has lost his memory. Gamosha deliberately tells Dinanath that his name is Gajodhar. Dinanath asks Trideviyaan to find out Gajodhar's contact details.

videos.title: Manu Plans to Restore Gamosha's Lost Memory
videos.overview: Gamosha, in the guise of Gajodhar, plans to perform puja in the house. Manu hits a ball to Gamosha. She tells Dinanath that she wishes to restore Gamosha's lost memory.

videos.title: Titu Escapes From the Jail
videos.overview: Titu escapes from the jail. Shaurya informs his colleagues that he has kept a tracker in Titu's pocket. Trideviyaan finds out that Gamosha has been kidnapped.

videos.title: Shaurya Arrests Titu
videos.overview: Trideviyaan will come to a temple to rescue Gamosha. Shaurya arrests Titu from the temple. Gamosha regains his memory.

videos.title: Trideviyaan in Trouble
videos.overview: Trideviyaan and Dinanath learn that Chanda Chaddha is trying to enter into the basement. Trideviyaan convince Chanda Chaddha that she is not keeping well.

videos.title: Gamosha Invites Dinanath's Family for Party
videos.overview: Gamosha comes to Dinanath's house. He invites all the family members for dinner party. Dhanu finds Gamosha's photograph in her house.

videos.title: Gamosha Kidnaps Dinanaths Family
videos.overview: Gamosha invites Dhanu and her family for a party. Dhanu informs Dinanath that their family has been kidnapped by Gamosha.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Gamosha reveals his true identity before Dinanath and his family. He decides to take revenge against Shaurya for hitting Titu.

videos.title: Diamond Ki Raksha
videos.overview: Dinanath informs Trideviyaan about an expensive Diamond kept in an exhibition. He tells them that they must protect the Diamond from theft.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Dinanath tells Trideviyaan that they must save the Pink Diamond from thieves. Dhanu and Tanu come to the Diamond exhibition in the guise of sculptors.

videos.title: Thief Steals the Pink Diamond
videos.overview: Trideviyaan comes to a museum to safeguard Pink Diamond. A thief secretly intrudes into the museum and steals the the Diamond.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Bring Pink Diamond to Their House
videos.overview: Trideviyaan bring Pink Diamond to their house. The soon learn that Shaurya may arrest them for stealing the the diamond.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Shaurya suggests Garv to let Manu keep Hiralal in their house. Dhanu tells Tanu and Manu that Shaurya may find out that Trideviyaan had stolen the Pink Diamond from the museum.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Manu tells Dinanath that Shaurya is determined to arrest the thief who has stolen the Pink Diamond. A goon steals Manu’s dog Hiralal in front of her eyes.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Chanda Chaddha tells Trideviyaan that she is aware that they had stolen Pink Diamond. Shaurya informs Trideviyaan that Mr. Patel will come to their house in the guise of an animal to take his pink diamond back.

videos.title: Dinanath Prepares Truth Serum
videos.overview: Shaurya arrests the thief who has stolen Pink Diamond. Trideviyaan gets shocked to see Dinanath dancing in their secret chamber. Dinanath tells Trideviyaan that he has prepared a 'truth serum' to arrest Satyawan.

videos.title: Manu Drinks the Truth Serum
videos.overview: Dinanath welcomes Muthuswamy to his house. Dhanu and Tanu find out that Manu has drunk the truth serum. Manu starts revealing Dinanath’s secrets before Muthuswamy.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Dhanu tells Tanu that Manu should not reveal their secrets to Muthuswamy. Manu meets Shaurya in a market and tells him that she is a secret agent.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Muthuswamy finds out that Dinanath is a secret agent. He points a gun towards Dinanath. However, Dinanath retaliates and beats Muthuswamy.

videos.title: Shauryas Family Return Home
videos.overview: Shaurya and his family secretly come into their house. Tanu and Garv plan to order food for them from a restaurant. Garv gets shocked to see a stranger in his house.

videos.title: Manu Ka Ghost
videos.overview: Garv and Shaurya find out that their family members have intruded into the house to watch a cricket match. Shaurya and his family get shocked to see Manu in the guise of a ghost.

videos.title: Dipika Comes to Shaurya's House
videos.overview: Trideviyaan get shocked to see Dipika Patnewali flirting with Shaurya and Garv in the police station. Shaurya welcomes Dipika Patnewali in his house.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Plan to Teach Dipika a Lesson
videos.overview: Dipika comes to Shaurya’s room for rehearsing her dialogues for her upcoming film. Dhanu and Tanu plan to teach Dipika a lesson for intruding into Shaurya’s room.

videos.title: Shaurya Spots Two Detectives
videos.overview: Dipika tells Manu that she wishes to meet Shaurya and Garv in the guise of a detective. Shaurya spots Dhanu and Tanu in their detective avatar in front of his house.

videos.title: Sam Cooper Comes to Dinanath's House
videos.overview: Sam Cooper comes to Dinanath’s house. He offers various roles to Shaurya and his family members in his alleged new film. While shooting, Shaurya finds out that Sam Cooper is a robber.

videos.title: Missile Chor
videos.overview: Manu and her family plan to go for a picnic. Dinanath learns that a missile has been stolen from a space agency. Dinanath plans to find out the missing missile.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Dinanath orders Trideviyaan to find a thief who has stolen a missile from space agency. Trideviyaan successfully nab the thief.

videos.title: Tanus Secret Video
videos.overview: Tanu tells Dinanath that Garv has forwarded their secret video to Shaurya’s mobile phone. Trideviyaan plan to delete the video from Shaurya’s phone.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Plan to Nab the Missile Thief
videos.overview: Trideviyaan promise Dinanath that soon they will nab the thief who had stolen the missile from the space agency. Two thieves plan to secretly smuggle the missile out of the country.

videos.title: Ghost in Dinanaths House
videos.overview: Shaurya brings a planchet to his house to invoke ghosts. Dinanath’s family members get frightened to paranormal activities in the house.

videos.title: Ghost Appears in Dhanus House
videos.overview: A ghost appears before Dhanu. She tells Dhanu that she will stay in her house until she finds out her murderer. Dhanu’s family get shocked to see her dressed as a south Indian woman.

videos.title: Ghost Enters Dinanath's House
videos.overview: Shaurya and his family learn that a ghost has entered their house. Garv brings a doctor to his house to check Dhanu’s health.

videos.title: Dinanath Plans to Attack a Ghost
Episode 84
videos.overview: Mohini’s ghost asks Manu to reveal the name of her murder. Manu’s family urge her to reveal the name of the murderer.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Manu informs her family that Mohini was hit by Rahul’s speeding car. Dhanu tells Dinanath that Mohini wanted to punish Rahul for his mistake.

videos.title: Manohar Meets Dinanath
videos.overview: Dhanu’s mother-in-law advises Trideviyaan to observe death anniversary of her father-in-law. A little boy enters Dinanath’s house in the guise of Manohar.

videos.title: Dhanu Forces Garv to Wear Saree
videos.overview: Manohar instructs Trideviyaan to prepare food for him. Tanu goes to a shop to buy sweets. Dhanu and Manu force Garv to wear a saree. Garv stands before Manohar in the guise of Tanu.

videos.title: Manohar Yells at Garv
videos.overview: Manohar yells at Garv for wearing saree and standing before him in the guise of Tanu. Later, Manohar advises Dinanath and his sons to not be afraid of their wives.

videos.title: Manohar Finds Out Shaurya's Secret
videos.overview: Dinanath, Shaurya and Garv apologize to their wives for hurting their feelings. Manohar gets shocked to see Shaurya’s fake moustache lying in his food.

videos.title: Goons Kidnap Manu
videos.overview: Dinanath observes transmitter in Manohar’s walking stick. Dhanu and Tanu find out that a few goons have kidnaped Manu.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Rescues Manu
videos.overview: Dinanath learns that his father has hidden a hazardous chemical in his house. Trideviyaan plan to rescue Manu from her kidnappers.

videos.title: Police Arrest Trideviyaan
videos.overview: The police arrest Trideviyaan for looting a bank. Magician Kilmish comes to Dinanath’s house and hypnotizes Shaurya and his family.

videos.title: Kilmish Hypnotizes Trideviyaan
videos.overview: Kilmish hypnotizes Trideviyaan with his magical powers. Trideviyaan call Garv and request him to release them from jail.

videos.title: Kilmish Comes to Dinanath's House
videos.overview: Kilmish comes to Dinanath’s house in the guise of a postman. Trideviyaan plans to attack Kilmish in their house.

videos.title: Kilmish Hypnotizes Dhanu's Family
videos.overview: Kilmish hypnotizes Dhanu’s family. He instructs them to attack Trideviyaan. Garv requests Kilmish to not cause any harm to his family members.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Hypnotize Kilmish
videos.overview: Trideviyaan inform their family that Kilmish had tried to hypnotize them on the earlier day. Garv invites Kilmish to a magic show. Trideviyaan hypnotize Kilmish in front of his audience.

videos.title: Tribals Attack Trideviyaan
videos.overview: Dhanu tells Shaurya that he should not have gone to Nasik for training. A few tribals enter Dinanath’s house and attack Trideviyaan.

videos.title: Katappi Demands a Key From Trideviyaan
videos.overview: Manu asks Katappi as to what he wants from Tanu. Katappi demands a key from Trideviyaan. Manu tells Katappi that she has lost the key.

videos.title: Katappi Attacks Trideviyaan
videos.overview: Dhanu tells Manu and Tanu that they must now allow Katappi to cause them any harm. Katappi and his aides attack Trideviyaan.

videos.title: Guddu Plans to Kill Trideviyaan
videos.overview: Guddu finds a trunk full of jewellery in a jungle. Guddu and his goons tie Trideviyaan to a rope and plan to kill them.

videos.title: Guddu Brings Trideviyaan to Jungle
videos.overview: Guddu and his goons bring Trideviyaan to a jungle to kill them all. Trideviyaan tells Guddu that they are aware about his evil intention.

videos.title: Charlie Trouble Trideviyaan
videos.overview: Trideviyaan learn that Charlie parrot is aware of their secret names. Manu tells Dhanu and Tanu that they should keep Charlie in birds rescue center.

videos.title: Musa Ka Secret Plan
videos.overview: Musa tells his parrot that he will force Trideviyaan to shake Mumbai city with bombs. Dinanath tells Trideviyaan that they must find out the bombs created by Musa.

videos.title: Ghost Party
videos.overview: Police commissioner and his wife come to Shaurya’s house on their marriage anniversary. They get terrified to see Trideviyaan and Dinanath in the costume of ghosts

videos.title: Trideviyaan Defuse Musa's Bombs
videos.overview: Musa’s parrot suggests Trideviyaan to find Musa’s bombs in a rickshaw. Trideviyaan find and defuse the bombs kept by Musa.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Expect a New Guest in Their House
videos.overview: Dinanath’s wife tells him that she is eagerly waiting to see her grandchildren. Garv assumes that his parents are planning for a baby.

videos.title: Dinanath Reveals the Secret of His Wife's Pregnancy
Children Create Havoc in Dinanath's House
videos.overview: Dinanath’s wife invites a few children from an NGO to her house. Trideviyaan inform Dinanath that a few men were trying to kidnap Vinay in a garden.

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: Children force Trideviyaan and their family to play hide and-seek with them. Two goons secretly enter Dinanath’s house.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Rescue Vinay
videos.overview: Trideviyaan rescue Vinay from his kidnappers. While returning home, Dinanath’s wife buys a lottery ticket.

videos.title: Dinanath's Wife Wins Lottery
videos.overview: Trideviyaan congratulate Dinanath’s wife as she wins a lottery. They soon learn that the lottery ticket is missing.

videos.title: Shaurya and Garv Plan to Search Lottery Ticket
videos.overview: Shaurya and Garv plan to find out their lottery ticket. Few pedestrian beat Garv as he tries to find his lottery ticket.

videos.title: Dinanath Plans to Rent Out His Guesthouse
Amar and Prem Come to Dinanath's House
videos.overview: Amar and Prem’s landlord throw them out of his house. Later, Amar and Prem come to Dinanath’s house in the guise of a married couple.

videos.title: Prem Plans to Meet Manu
videos.overview: Prem calls Manu and asks her to meet him in person. Amar advises Prem to stay away from Manu and her family.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Plan to Find Out Prem's Past
videos.overview: Fatte tells Dinanath that they must do background check of their tenants. Trideviyaan plan to find out the secret of Amar and Promila’s love affair.

videos.title: Dhanu Decides to Verify Amar and Prem's Past
videos.overview: Prem tells Manu that she would find her life partner by the evening. Dinanath asks Amar as to where he met his wife for the first time. On the other hand, Trideviyaan ask the same question to Prem to verify his past.

videos.title: Amar Displays Hair Wigs to Dinanath
videos.overview: Amar tells Dinanath and his family that he has several hair wigs. He displays some of them to Dinanath. Dhanu asks Amar to bring Promila out of her room.

videos.title: Shaurya Plans to Arrest Ustara Man
videos.overview: Shaurya tells his team that they must arrest Ustara Man at the earliest. Dinanath assumes that his tenant Amar is a goon.

videos.title: Mission Ustara Man
videos.overview: Dhanu tells Tanu and Manu that they must find out 'ustara man'. Trideviyaan plan to find out the relationship between 'ustara man' and Dinanath.

videos.title: Shaurya Plans to Arrest Ustara Man
Shaurya Decides to Arrest Ustara Man
Dinanath Plans Amar and Promila's Wedding
videos.overview: A couple demand 5 lakh rupees from Prem. Dinanath’s family plan to organize Amar and Promila’s wedding.

videos.title: Dhanu Plans to Give Jewellery to Promila
videos.overview: The show explores two Sankaari Bahu's , Dhanshree and Tanuja along with their nanad Manya. Both the bahu's are well trained secret special agents. They have been chosen by their Boss who is none other than their Sasurji. This fact is hidden from the rest of the family. So these three will have to play two roles of managing their household chores as well as solving national conflicts and their biggest challenge will be to fight with the might and dangerous DON GAMASHA

videos.title: Mission Amar
videos.overview: Prem tells Trideviyaan that Vinayak and Alka would kill Amar if he fails to give them money. Trideviyaan plan to rescue Amar from his kidnappers.

videos.title: Dinanath Plans to Go to Delhi
videos.overview: Dinanath informs his family that he is going to Delhi on the next day. Dinanath arranges a competition between Trideviyaan to select the captain of their team.

videos.title: Dinanath Instructs Trideviyaan to Catch Thief
videos.overview: Dinanath instructs Trideviyaan to catch a thief. Manu tells Amar and Prem that she is aware of their secret.

videos.title: Dinanath Appoints Manu as Captain
videos.overview: Dinanath appoints Manu as the captain of his team. He instructs Dhanu and Tanu to follow Manu’s orders.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Meet Dummy Trideviyaan
videos.overview: A few thieves steal donation money from a charitable event. Trideviyaan plan to catch the thieves. Trideviyaan get shocked to see dummy Trideviyaan in television.

videos.title: Dummy Trideviyaan in Dinanath's House
videos.overview: Dummy Trideviyaan come to Dinanath’s house. They tell the real Trideviyaan that they are secret agents.

videos.title: Prem Plans to Reveal His Secret to Dinanath
videos.overview: Prem tells Amar that he is going to inform Dinanath that he loves Manu. On the other hand, Manu tells Dhanu and Tanu that they must expose the real identity of Fake Trideviyaan.

videos.title: Manu Plans to Expose Fake Trideviyaan
videos.overview: Kamlesh tells her colleagues that they must stay away from Trideviyaan. Later. Manu tells Dhanu and Tanu that Fake Trideviyaan are contract killers.

videos.title: Fake Trideviyyan Land in Trouble
videos.overview: Few terrorists attack a school and take the school children as hostages. Garv asks fake Trideviyyan to save the children from the terrorists. Fake Trideviyyan reveal their true identities to Trideviyyan.

videos.title: Trideviyaan on Hit List of Terrorists
videos.overview: Dhanu tells Manu that a few terrorists might attack them in near future. Trideviyaan plan to keep themselves away from strangers.

videos.title: Baba Satyavan Comes to Dinanath's House
videos.overview: Baba Satyavan comes to Dinanath’s house. Dhanu tells Manu that they should stay away from Baba Satyavan.

videos.title: Baba Satyavan Finds Out Prem's Secret
videos.overview: Amar tells Suhasini’s family that his wife Promila is not keeping well. Trideviyaan assume that Promila is pregnant. Baba Satyavan finds out that Prem is staying in Dinanath’s house in the guise of a woman.

videos.title: Baba Satyavan Plans to Kill Amar and Prem
videos.overview: Baba Satyavan plans to kill Amar and Prem. Manu finds a gun in Baba Satyavan’s room. Trideviyaan find out that Baba Satyavan is a thug.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Plan to Punish Baba Satyavan
videos.overview: Manu informs Dhanu that she had found a gun in Baba Satyavan’s room. Trideviyaan learn that Baba Satyavan is planning to kill Amar and Prem.

videos.title: Manu and Dhanu Attack Baba Satyavan
videos.overview: Manu and Dhanu attack Baba Satyavan and save Amar, Prem and Suhasini from their kidnapper. Suhasini assumes that Dinanath is involved in an extramarital affair.

videos.title: Dinanath in Trouble
videos.overview: Suhasini yells at Dinanath for having extramarital affair with Bharati. Dinanath clears it to Suhasini that he is not involved in extramarital relationship.

videos.title: Bharti Enters Dinanath's House
videos.overview: Titu’s girlfriend enters Dinanath’s house in the guise of Bharti. She tells Shaurya’s family that she is Dinanath’s wife.

videos.title: Dinanath Ka Secret Plan
videos.overview: Dinanath tells Bharti that he would soon divorce his wife. Manu tells Suhasini that Dinanath wants to find out Bharti’s secret plan.

videos.title: Suhasini Wins Against Bharti
videos.overview: Dinanath’s family arrange a competition between Bharti and Suhasini to perform household chores. Suhasini stands out as winner at the end of the competition. Dhanu finds a tattoo on Bharti’s back.

videos.title: Bharti Holds Shaurya's Family Hostage
videos.overview: Bharti informs Dinanath that she has tied Promila and Suhasini to a bomb. Shaurya learns that Bharti has hold his family hostage.

videos.title: Garv Ki First Date Anniversary
videos.overview: Garv and Tanu plan to celebrate their ‘first date’ anniversary. However, Garv’s family prevents him from spending the day with Tanu.

videos.title: Champak Enters Dinanath's House
videos.overview: Champak and his aides stand before Dinanath’s house. They plan to intrude into the house to recover their money. Champak tells Dinanath and his family that he  is a chef.

videos.title: Champak Ka Secret Plan
videos.overview: The Chauhan housheold is visited by a notorious Bank Chor, played by Riteish Deshmukh, who wants to retrieve his cash-filled bag from the house. Despite his failed the attempts, the Bank Chor finally achieves his target by sedating the family members at night. Will Dhanu, Tanu and Manu be able to nab the culprit?

videos.title: Trideviyaan in Trouble
videos.overview: Trideviyaan break into a laboratory where an evil scientist has developed a chemical weapon which impairs the sensory organs. The daring women successfully sabotage the scientists plan. However, the chemical weapon suddenly explodes and Trideviyaan accidentally inhale the toxic fumes. Soon, the ladies discover that their sensory perceptions have been impaired.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Become Deaf, Dumb and Blind
videos.overview: Following the explosion in the lab, Dhanu has lost her vision, Manu her hearing and Tanu her voice. After returning home, they find it hard to carry out simple tasks. When Shaurya arrives, Dhanu tries to conceal the fact that she is blind. She pretends to be unconsciousness in the presence of Shaurya.

videos.title: Tanu in Trouble
videos.overview: Dhanu, Tanu and Manu are having a hard time concealing their sensory impairments. Meanwhile, Manu comes with an amazing plan to help out Dhanu. Manu asks Dhanu to measure her steps and identify the objects inside the house. Dinanath agrees to the plan and joins the ladies in realising the plan.

videos.title: Trideviyaan Hide Manu's Secret From Their Guests
videos.overview: Dhanu, Tanu and Manu are having a hard time concealing their sensory impairments. Tanu's tape recorder malfunctions and she nearly ends up getting caught. Dhanu, Tanu, and Manu learn that Shaurya is searching for the three women who stole the bomb.

videos.title: Dinanath Meets Professor Bhaskar
videos.overview: Agent Lalwani suspects that something is wrong with Dhanu, Tanu and Manu.  Dinanath Chohan calls them up and informs that he will be reaching their house. Meanwhile, Dhanu, Tanu, and Manu hide the fact that Lalwani is a secret agent from their respective husbands.

videos.title: Manu's Nightmare
videos.overview: Dinanath Chohan saves the day for Dhanu, Tanu, and Manu. The girls manage to fool Agent Lalwani and he leaves. Then, Dinanath brings an antitode, that will cure Dhanu, Tanu, and Manu's senses. Finally, the girls are back to the normal. Later, Dinanath shows the secret agents that Shaurya has apprehended the terrorist, who is responsible for the bomb blast.

videos.title: Manu's Dreams Turn Into Reality
videos.overview: Someone knocks on the door and Manu gets terrified. Manu suspects that someone has come to kill her. It turns out that Prem is the certain someone who has been knocking on the door. Dhanu and Tanu call up Manu to inquire. Manu hides the fact that Prem is in the house from Dhanu and Tanu.

videos.title: Manus Superpower
videos.overview: Dinanath Chohan is furious at Manu for forgetting about her mission. Dhanu convinces Tanu and her father in law that Manu's special power of seeing actual things while dreaming will help them to complete the mission. Watch the episode of Trideviyaan to find out what happens next!

videos.title: Abort Mission!
videos.overview: Manu has a dream in which she sees Dhanu and Tanu getting caught in their latest mission. When Manu learns that her sister-in-laws have already for the mission, she devises a plan to make them forfeit the mission. She decides to call up Shaurya and request him to take Dhanu for a movie. Will Manu be able to convince her brother? Find out!

videos.title: Kidnapped!
videos.overview: Manu's plan to make Prem kidnap her backfires as real kidnappers pick her up from her house. Although, initially Dhanu, took this disappearing act of Manu as a prank, they soon realized that Manu is in real trouble. Will they be able to rescue her in time? Watch to find out more.

videos.title: Manu Is Fired!
videos.overview: Dinanath Chohan fires Manu from duty. Dhanu and Tanu persuade Manu to request Dinanath Chohan to reinstate her. Dinanath agrees to reinstate Manu. Then, Shaurya calls up Dhanu and informs her that he will be out of town on work. Later. a mysterious woman is assigned to take the place of Dinanath's secret agent.

videos.title: Dhanu, Tanu, and Manus Night Out
videos.overview: Dhanu, Tanu and Manu hed out for an evening together. The terrorist gang, which has been trying to sabotage the mission of the Trideviyaan, follows them closely behind. Will Bijli, who has been hired to take the place of Tanu, succeed in her evil intentions? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Manu's Secret
videos.overview: Dhanu assures Dinanath that she is safe. Then, she informs him that she had locked Manu inside the car but they found her outside the car later. Dinanath suspects that something is wrong. Will his worst fears come true? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Tanu Kidnapped
videos.overview: Dinanath learns that one of his secret agents has been kidnapped. Meanwhile, Tanu, who has been confined by her kidnappers, tries to find a way to contact Dinanath. Dhanu and Manu are still unaware that Tanu has been kidnapped.

videos.title: The Duplicate Agent Is Revealed
videos.overview: While Dhanu and Manu doubt each other to be the duplicate agent, Dinanath sets up a trap to catch the real intruder. He catches the duplicate Tanu, who was trying to steal the hard disk, red-handed in his office. However, Bijli, who imposter who was pretending to be Tanu, manages to escape with the hard disk. Can Dhanu and Manu catch her before it is too late? Watch to find out.

videos.title: Tanu Walks Free
videos.overview: Dhanu and Manu barge into the hideout, where Tanu has been kept in confinement. They manage to overpower Bijli and release Tanu. Seeing the kidnappers approaching, Tanu pretends to be Bijli, while Manu and Dhanu confine Bijli.

videos.title: A Knock on the Door
videos.overview: Dhanu, Manu, and Tanu head out of the house, leaving the boys all alone. The boys enjoy the game of cricket while the wives are out. Then, thanks to the rain God, rain drizzles in the city. Amidst the rain, two alluring women knock on the door. Who are these women and what is their intention? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Shaurya and Garv Blackmailed
videos.overview: Shaurya and Garv are unable to get rid of Angel and Pari, who are demanding a ransom from them in order to leave and threatens them with pictures of them being cuddled by these girls. They order pizza but are shocked to find out that their wives have returned early. Will Dhanu and Tanu find out about the girls, who have gone into hiding?

videos.title: Angel's Ominous Presence
videos.overview: Dhanu and Tanu's husbands try to hide the presence of Angel and Pari. Shaurya showers Dhanu with praises to distract her from Angel, who is hiding inside the wardrobe. Left without a choice, Shaurya also hides inside the wardrobe and locks it from inside. Will Dhanu find out about Angel and Pari's presence? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Dinanath Gets Electrocuted
videos.overview: After cracking a complicated security code with a slight help from Fateh, Dinanath Chauhan hurries to the den to transfer the code to the chief. However, Dinanath is shocked to see that the den has been flooded with water during the rains. While trying to secure the equipments inside the den, Dinanath gets electrocuted and falls unconscious. Find out what happens next!

videos.title: Rashtrabhasha
videos.overview: Dhanu, Tanu and Manu take on a new avatar to help Dinanath get back to his old self. Dinanath, following the electric shock, has grown new fond affection for the Hindi language. Dhanu, Tanu and Manu follow suit in an attempt to cure Dinanath.

videos.title: Dinanath Pursuit of Truth
videos.overview: Dhanu, Tanu, and Manu take down the drug dealers, but they realize that their troubles have just begun when they come to know that Dinanath has once again suffered a memory loss and is following them along with his son to uncover their truth. Will they be able to salvage the situation? Watch to find out.

videos.title: Dinanath's Mysterious Secret Revealed
videos.overview: Dhanu, Tanu and Manu discover the secret behind Dinanath's memory loss. When Shaurya sees his father behaving odd, he calls up the doctor, unaware that Dhanu, Tanu and Manu have called him regarding Dinanath's problem. Will the doctor be able to solve their woes?

videos.title: Prems Secret
videos.overview: The family members discover that Dinanath has recovered completely. When Manu sees Promila, she senses that something is fishy. Later, when she goes to Garv's room she stumbles upon a huge secret involving Prem.

videos.title: Advocate Manu
videos.overview: Dhanu tries to protect his brother from the hands of her husband, who doubts that he has killed his wife. Shaurya tries to arrest him but Manu comes to his rescue by being his advocate. She also arranges a bail for him. However, Shaurya promises to come back with evidence against him. Is Raja guilty? Watch to find out.

videos.title: A Letter for Raja
videos.overview: Dinanath learns from Tanu that Raja had an extramarital affair with a girl named Malini. Tanu tries to leave the house to investigate about Malini but she fails to escape the notice of Manu and Dhanu. Meanwhile, a postman arrives at their house to deliver a letter for Raja from Malini. What secret does the letter contain? Watch to find out.

videos.title: Dhanu's Injury
videos.overview: Dhanu falls down from a stool after a mysterious assassin shoots at the stool. Shaurya is worried when he learns about Dhanu's injury and rushes by her side. He receives a phone call from a gangster, who threatens to kill Dhanu.

videos.title: Bodyguard Hawa Singh
videos.overview: Shaurya appoints constable Hawa Singh as a bodyguard to take care of Dhanu, Manu and Tanu. However, Dinanath assumes that he is King D's henchman and attacks him. Later, Dinanath informs Dhanu, Tanu and Manu that King D is aware about Shaurya and their whereabouts.

videos.title: Decoding King d'S Call
videos.overview: Dinanath, Dhanu, Tanu and Manu decide to decode King D's call and discover that he is calling from the same police station where Shaurya is commissioned. They analyse and suspect that King D could be Firdaus Lala.

videos.title: Naagin Prank
videos.overview: Knowing that Garv is afraid of snakes, Tanu and other family members play a prank on him. He forgives them. However, he is horrified when two women appear as Naagin and ask him for a secret Nagmani.

videos.title: Missing Diamond
videos.overview: Dinanath assigns Dhanu, Tanu and Manu an assignment to find a missing diamond. However, he is unaware that the diamond has been hidden in his own garden. Will he be able to find the thief?

videos.title: Diamond Thief
videos.overview: Garv is continuously being blackmailed by an Icchapyaari Naagin, who is infact a thief, for a Nagmani, which happens to be a diamond. When Tanu discovers that Garv is in trouble, she decides to help him and hatches a plan to expose the Icchapyaari Naagin.

videos.title: Operation Vikrant
videos.overview: Shaurya informs Dhanu that he has been transferred to Nagpur after he was forced to release an influential politician's son, Vikrant, due to lack of evidence. Dhanu, along with Tanu and Manu, decides to launch 'Operation Vikrant' to help Shaurya.

videos.title: Shaurya's Hunt for Trideviyaan
videos.overview: When Shaurya is accused of being helped by Trideviyaan to solve his cases, he decides to track them down. While on his quest to find them, he and Garv find a red shoe, which belongs to one of the ladies. Will he be able to track the ladies?

videos.title: The Key Suspects
videos.overview: Garv and Shaurya suspect that someone from Dhanu, Tanu and Manu is one of the Trideviyaan, and have helped them crack several cases. When they devise a plan to find the truth from the ladies, the ladies deny any involvement.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Dhanu and Tanu realise that Shaurya and Garv have set a trap to catch the Trideviyaan. When Manu calls them and informs them that she has reached the location, they ask her to leave from there. Will she get caught by Shaurya and Garv?

videos.title: The Grand Reunion
videos.overview: Dhanu is elated when she discovers that Shaurya isn't transferred and that they will not have to leave the city. Dinanath gets extremely emotional when he sees the family together and remembers his wife Suhasini. The family is extremely happy when she returns from her family trip.
